steps.en: Officer rejects sending a Letter of Advice on the LOA list screen
steps.id: Officer menolak kirim Letter of Advice di layar daftar
steps.why_en: Only a text label exists; no list screen or reject action is built.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada label teks; layar daftar dan aksi tolak tidak dibangun.

steps.en: OCMS saves the reject decision on the notice or defendant
steps.id: OCMS menyimpan keputusan tolak di notice/defendant
steps.why_en: No place to store the decision exists in the system.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada tempat menyimpan keputusan di sistem.

steps.en: OCMS excludes the notice and defendant from the Letter of Advice list
steps.id: OCMS mengeluarkan notice dan defendant dari daftar
steps.why_en: There is no Letter of Advice list to remove them from.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada daftar Letter of Advice untuk dikeluarkan darinya.

steps.en: The Letter of Advice is not sent to the defendant
steps.id: Letter of Advice tidak dikirim ke defendant
steps.why_en: No sending feature exists, so nothing is excluded by logic.
steps.why_id: Fitur kirim tidak ada, jadi tidak ada pengecualian lewat logic.
